target: How to Cook an LLM interactive article
purpose: PostTrainLLM helps learners understand model development by making inspectable decisions about data, training examples, feedback, and inference.

directions.name: Illustrated essay
directions.audience: First-time LLM learners on the existing research site
directions.screenJob: Read a guided article and inspect inline decisions
directions.visualThesis: A reading-first editorial essay with integrated line illustrations, a single prose column, marginal technical notes, and inline exercises.
directions.typography: Georgia editorial display/prose; sans-serif exercises; monospace annotations
directions.colorRoles: Paper canvas; olive diagrams; forest actions; dark serif headings.
directions.layout: A reading-first editorial essay with integrated line illustrations, a single prose column, marginal technical notes, and inline exercises.
directions.interactionThesis: Scroll through the narrative; make a small decision at the relevant paragraph.
directions.signature: An illustrated ingredient-to-recipe lifecycle and technical marginalia.
directions.risk: Interactions could be overlooked by readers focused on prose.

directions.name: Explore the kitchen
directions.audience: Beginners arriving for an approachable explainer
directions.screenJob: Read a recipe and complete small preparation sheets
directions.visualThesis: A spatial illustrated kitchen with three selectable stations and a shared contextual inspector beneath the map.
directions.typography: Sans-serif station labels/headings; monospace technical labels
directions.colorRoles: Forest canvas; sage equipment; warm gold current station; paper inspector.
directions.layout: A spatial illustrated kitchen with three selectable stations and a shared contextual inspector beneath the map.
directions.interactionThesis: Choose a station, act on its materials, then inspect the data-versus-weights consequence.
directions.signature: Clickable preparation counter, stove, and tasting table reveal the model lifecycle.
directions.risk: Spatial exploration needs a strong linear and accessible fallback.

directions.name: Experiment notebook
directions.audience: Learners who prefer doing before reading
directions.screenJob: Complete stations while inspecting technical state
directions.visualThesis: A compact notebook document with execution gutters, code cells, output receipts, and a checkpoint comparison table.
directions.typography: Compact sans-serif document headings; monospace execution cells
directions.colorRoles: White document; neutral cell surfaces; blue execution actions; green data output.
directions.layout: A compact notebook document with execution gutters, code cells, output receipts, and a checkpoint comparison table.
directions.interactionThesis: Run preparation, inspect the result, compare checkpoints, collect a preference.
directions.signature: Every execution cell declares whether data or weights changed.
directions.risk: Code may make a beginner article feel more technical.
